title: Profession leveling: maxed means done
text: A profession at 300 now shows "Done" instead of "299 → 300". Skills from your game files are read up to 300.

title: Level route: going back only when it pays
text: The route sends you back to an earlier zone only when that gives more XP per minute than moving on, trip included. Quests that need a crafted or auction house item are left out. Vendor items get a "buy" tag.

title: Level route: drop quests
text: Slow drop quests are left out. The rest say about how many kills, and earlier stops with the same monsters say "Also here".

title: Level route: maps and travel
text: The world map shows your next stop. Zone maps show the zone's name on top. Walks no longer cross the mountains into Burning Steppes. Back shows the stop before when there's nothing to undo.

title: Level route: right quest spots, quests done together
text: Kill and loot spots now sit where the monsters crowd, not at a lone spawn. Quests in the same spot are done together, and hand-ins come as soon as you pass by.

title: Level route: clearer notes
text: Guide notes now use short, plain words, and notes that didn't help are gone. Auction house reminders wait until you reach a town with an auction house.

title: Level route: same plan when you load your files again
text: Load your files again while you play and the going-back plan stays the same. Going back starts in the zone you are in.

title: Level route: your XP bar
text: With Gear Snapshot 1.10 the route shows your XP bar and the level you reach at the next hand-in. Quests to abandon are listed too.

title: Gear upgrades: our own item list
text: Items now come from the game's own files, not an addon: about 8,000 quest rewards, dungeon drops, crafts and BoEs, with Forever's changed stats. Raid quest gear is left out, and class-only quest rewards only show for that class.

title: Gear upgrades: our own stat weights
text: Gear scores now use our own leveling sims for every class and spec, not an addon's weights. Damage specs: kills per hour, counting rest and deaths. Tanks and healers: dungeon pulls per hour.

title: Gear upgrades: your character in 3D
text: See your character in 3D, wearing your gear. Drag to turn. Hover a slot to try on its best upgrade.

title: New: Farm finder
text: Which monsters at your level drop the most gold per kill: each drop's chance, price, how fast it sells and its trend. With Gear Snapshot 1.9, your own loot sets the chances and your gold an hour. Mat timing and Sell spare mats now show price vs usual and a trend line too.

title: Level route: going back picks up quests first
text: Going back now sends you to pick up a quest before its kills or hand-in, and to finish the quest before it first. Quests you can't get any more stay hidden. Checked on every route.

title: Level route: upgrade arrow like the game's
text: Quest rewards that beat your gear show the game's green arrow and the item in green.

title: Craft finder: real AH deposits, cleaner numbers
text: Deposits now match the game: vendor price × 5% (2h), 20% (8h) or 60% (24h), back when it sells. Profit shows green or red, with price and deposits underneath.

title: Side menu shows how fresh prices are
text: AH prices now show when your auction house's prices last updated. Nothing to load for prices: they update hourly. Backup files (TSM, Questie, Shortest Path) only show when Gear Snapshot is not loaded.

title: Level route: sharper close-up map
text: Zoomed-in maps now look crisp like the game's minimap. Picking a step shows the whole zone.

title: Profession leveling: "makes 2 per craft"
text: Steps whose recipe makes more than one item now say so: Undermine Clam Chowder makes 2 a craft, so money back is 2 times its 1s vendor price per craft.

title: Clearer maps and hover cards
text: Point at an item to see a game-style tooltip with Forever's own stats. NPC maps zoom in, the route's World map shows where your zone is, and stop numbers are easier to read.

title: Profession leveling: no more one-point detours
text: The route no longer switches to another recipe for a point or two when it saves almost nothing (one point of Jungle Stew between Rockscale Cod and Spider Sausage). A switch now has to save over 10%, so you buy fewer different materials.

title: Level 1-60 route: Skyborne druid cat form
text: Skyborne druids now get their own cat form quests (The Great Windborne Cat Spirit) instead of the Night Elf ones. Quest search shows the chain for your race. Checked against Blizzard's quest data.

title: Talent planner
text: Plan your talents on Forever's own trees, for every class. Pick your level and the Talented perk to see how many points you have, then share the build with a link.

title: Patch and server status
text: Load game files now shows the game's patch, and whether each auction house is getting new prices. If yours stops updating for 2 hours (servers down), the site tells you once that prices are older.
linkText: How to load your game files

title: Flips and deals: auction house deals and Booty Bay flips
text: Vendor flips is now Flips and deals. Deals lists auction house items well under their usual price that do sell. Booty Bay flips are items to buy at Booty Bay and sell on your faction's auction house, or the other way round, with the auction house cut counted. Both start Saturday, after 3 days of sales are counted.

title: Level 1-60 route: clear "going back" stops
text: When the route sends you back to an earlier part, that part now says how many stops to do there, marks them GO, folds the rest as skip, and flags the last one. The button at the bottom takes you back to where you left off instead of the next part.

title: Real cost to buy, and sales on your own auction house
text: Profession leveling now shows what buying everything really costs once the cheap listings run out, or how few are listed. Craft finder counts sales on your own auction house every hour; after 3 full days it uses those instead of TSM to tell you if an item sells, with a day-by-day table.

title: Your own auction house, found from your scan
text: Hourly prices from Blizzard now cover every auction house: Horde, Alliance and neutral, in the US and Europe. Load a scan once and the site finds which one is yours, then keeps your prices fresh every hour, even when your scan gets old. Or pick it under Load game files.

title: Profession leveling: recipe prices on the auction house
text: Each recipe, pattern and formula now shows its auction house price and how many are listed, next to the vendor price, so you can skip a long trip. If only the other faction's vendor sells it, the route counts the auction house price.

title: Level 1-60 route: every quest, your chains, Dungeons switch
text: The route now picks up quests it used to skip, and search finds every quest on Forever with its chain. Quests in your log that the route skipped are added where it passes, if they still give XP (Leave out to drop one). If you skipped a chain step, the route goes back for it when the XP beats the travel time or it has a gear upgrade, and leaves the chain out if not. New Dungeons switch: off skips dungeons and their quests, on brings them back.

title: Fresh prices with no addon
text: Every price page now gets the Horde auction house's prices every hour, with how many are listed, even if you load nothing. They come straight from Blizzard's auction data, with prices for random suffixes (like "of the Owl") too. Your own scan still wins.

title: Prices from Gear Snapshot, no Auctionator needed
text: Gear Snapshot 1.8 has its own Scan button at the auction house, with a % so you know when it's done. It saves the price of every item and every random suffix (like "of the Owl"), plus 14 days of history. Every price page uses it, so Auctionator is now optional. It also saves the prices when Auctionator scans, the flight points you know for the Level 1-60 route, and your spec from your talents for Gear upgrades.

title: Bags and bank from Gear Snapshot, no TSM needed
text: Gear Snapshot 1.7 now saves what's in your bags, bank and mailbox, for all your characters on the same side. Profession leveling and the Craft finder read it for "I have", so you no longer need TradeSkillMaster. Each count carries the time it was saved, so an old bags file can't sneak back in.

title: Leveling: go back for what you skipped
text: Your start now sends you back first for a skipped gear upgrade, dungeon or full-XP quests. Hover the chips to see why, or press Skip to keep going.

title: Leveling: trips on the world map, clearer places
text: Hover a travel line on the Leveling route (tap on a phone) to see the trip on the game's own continent or world map, with flight points and the icon of what you do there. When your next place is in another zone, a small map in the corner of the zone map shows how to get there. Places now show their numbered pin and who or where they are, like ② Flight master, Brackenwall Village, instead of "stop 2".

title: Leveling: start where you are
text: Load GearSnapshot.lua (Gear Snapshot 1.6) and the Leveling route reads your finished quests and your quest log straight from the game, so it no longer misses quests like Questie did. A new "Your start" box shows the best stop for your level and how to get there from where you are. It also counts quests ready to turn in, XP left behind, quest rewards that beat your gear, and dungeons you've started.

title: Point at an NPC to see where they stand
text: On Profession leveling, NPC names (trainers, vendors, quest givers) now open a card with their picture, town and a map with a marker. Tap a name on a phone. Once the site knows your race, you only see your own faction's NPCs.

title: Profession leveling: vendor prices per item
text: "Sell to vendor" now shows what a vendor pays for one item, like the in-game tooltip. Before, recipes that make several items at once (like Anti-Venom, which makes 3) showed the price of all of them.

title: New: Dungeons page
text: Every Forever dungeon in one place: the map with each boss numbered, what each boss drops (upgrades for your spec marked), its quests and how to get in. Your Leveling route links to it, and each dungeon stop on the route now shows the map and bosses.

title: Craft finder: every crafting profession
text: The Tailoring finder is now the Craft finder. Pick Alchemy, Blacksmithing, Cooking, Enchanting, Engineering, First Aid, Leatherworking or Tailoring to see which crafts make a profit right now. Recipes that make several at once show the price of one.

title: Leveling: boss drops that are upgrades for you
text: Each dungeon on the Leveling route now lists the boss drops that beat the gear your quests gave you by then, for the spec you pick. Hover an item to see the boss and its drop chance.

title: Leveling: close-up maps, map icons and quest areas
text: Zoom in on the Leveling map to see the game's own close-up map, like in game. Flight masters, boats, zeppelins and dungeon entrances show as small icons. Quest objectives show as blue areas, and quests with several spots (like Strange Pylons) take you to each one, with its name and coordinates under the quest. The route also takes quests as soon as they open, does quests on the same monsters together (about 5 hours less travel) and marks elite quests. Quests that start from a looted item (like Tattered Journal) are now in the route, and Desolace follows the Magram clan for casters and Gelkis for everyone else.

title: Leveling: class quests and every dungeon quest
text: The route now has your class quests (pets, mounts, forms, totems) and about 40 more dungeon quests from the Dungeon Journal, like Agamaggan's Blood. Shen'dralas is in the route too, and far-off dungeon quests are one switch away (Optional quests). Every dungeon quest shows its dungeon, and far-off quests with a gear upgrade for your spec are in the route.

title: The game's own icons
text: Prices show gold, silver and copper coins. Quests, dungeons, vendors, trainers and the auction house have their in-game icons.

title: Level 1-60 route
text: A new Leveling page: every quest from level 1 to 60 in order for your race and class, on the zone map, with flights, trainer visits and every dungeon at the right level (with the boss to kill for Legacy points). Load Questie and it starts where you are.

title: Prices for “of Shadow Wrath” and every other suffix
text: Gear upgrades now prices each suffix version of a green (of the Owl, of the Monkey…) straight from your Auctionator full scan, so they show up as upgrades you can buy.

title: Which auction house to use
text: Gear upgrades now says Horde auction house. Booty Bay, Gadgetzan and Everlook have their own listings, so the site's items may not be there.

title: Home: your next steps
text: Pick your class and level once, and Home shows your 3 next steps for gear, professions and gold.

title: Alliance players: a note on prices
text: The site's prices come from the Horde auction house. If your character is Alliance, price pages now say so and offer to load your own scan.

title: Vendor flips
text: A new Gold page: recipes whose materials cost less than a vendor pays for what you make, and auction items listed under their vendor price.

title: Tailoring finder: every recipe
text: All 416 Tailoring recipes are in, with a new Runecloth group (Felcloth and Mooncloth crafts too), so you can find things like Felblood Soul Bag.

title: Profession leveling: every profession
text: Alchemy, Blacksmithing, Engineering, Leatherworking, First Aid and Cooking get the cheapest route, like Tailoring. Mining, Herbalism, Skinning and Fishing get a where-to-go guide. It also says how many bolts to make.

title: Mat timing: bolts, and a fresher census
text: Cloth bolts have their own cards, with "Make it" when a bolt sells well above its cloth. The level census now refreshes itself, and Enchants uses it too.

title: Game files: fixes for Chrome
text: Tools now read the right Auctionator file (some kept old prices). If Chrome won't link a folder inside Program Files, pick the WTF folder instead.

title: Prices: cheaper or pricier than usual
text: Mat timing and Sell spare mats now mark prices well under (↓) or over (↑) their usual price from the last 7 days. Hover or tap the mark for the numbers.

title: Gear upgrades: what you can wear now comes first
text: Each slot lists gear you can wear now first, then gear for later. Items with random stats ("of Shadow Wrath") show the best one for your spec, with its price.

title: Gear upgrades: "Upgrade now" or "From level X"
text: Every item now says if you can wear it now, or from which level. Also fixed: the page sometimes loaded empty after a site update.

title: Link your WoW folder once
text: In Chrome or Edge, pick your _forever_ folder once. The site finds your game files and reads the newest ones on every visit. Other browsers: pick the WTF folder.

title: Tailoring finder: patterns you have
text: Switch between all patterns and the ones you know (ticked from your game files). Patterns you don't have say where to get them. Simpler filters.

title: The site is live
text: All WoW Forever tools now have their own pages: gear upgrades for every class, Tailoring & Enchanting leveling, enchants, tailoring gold, mat timing and the Warlock guide. Load your game files once and every tool uses them; without them you get a recent Horde auction house scan. Something wrong? Use Report a problem.
